name: Step-Up Notice
description: An inline warning that explains a required fresh verification and hosts the caller’s verification action.
usage:
<StepUpNotice
  title="Confirm it's you"
  action={<Button size="sm">Verify with passkey</Button>}
>
  Approving a repair requires fresh verification.
</StepUpNotice>

anatomy.description: Built on Alert with the warning variant and its status semantics.
Bold lead-in naming the verification requirement.
Children text describing why fresh verification is required.
Caller-supplied verification control, such as a passkey Button; the notice never starts verification itself.
Optional dismiss control rendered when onDismiss is passed.

dos: State which action needs verification and why in the body copy.
Render the caller's verification control as the action so the flow stays product-owned.
donts: Don't use StepUpNotice for plain warnings; use Alert.
Don't make the notice dismissible when verification is mandatory to proceed.

examples.title: Verification required
examples.description: The action is caller-supplied; the notice never starts verification on its own.

examples.title: Dismissible
examples.description: Pass onDismiss when the notice is informational rather than blocking.

guidance.useWhen: A sensitive action requires fresh strong authentication first.
guidance.avoidWhen: A plain warning suffices; use Alert instead.
guidance.behavior: The verification action is caller-supplied; the notice never starts or auto-submits verification.
guidance.responsive: The action wraps beneath the explanation on narrow screens.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the caller-supplied verification action and the dismiss control.
Activates the verification action or dismiss control.

notes: Built on Alert with the warning variant, so it renders role="status" and is announced politely.
Supply a labeled control as the action, such as a Button; it keeps its own accessible name.
